source: S. Mishra and A. A. Kherani, "On the Control of Binary RIS Under User Mobility", IEEE Wireless Communications Letters 14(4), April 2025, pp. 1139-1143
transcribed: 2026-10-10, by hand from Sec. II-A, III-B and IV-A of the letter (values only; no text or figures copied)

parameters.mobility: 1-D random waypoint, constant speed, no pause (Sec. II-A)
parameters.urap_definition: p(n, x) = p for all n, x; Eq. (9) is the integral of |S_LOS + sum_n p S_NLOS,n|^2 f_X(x) dx (power of the mean field)
parameters.tau_sui: State Update Interval: the controller learns the user location every tau_SUI (Sec. IV-D)
parameters.ap_position: corridor origin, on the user line (Fig. 1)

not_stated_in_the_source: the numerical values plotted in Figs. 5, 7 and 8 (no tables)
which v1 commit the letter's simulator used (H-1)
sremu_deviations: AP offset d0 = 0.5 m perpendicular to the user line (DESIGN.md 10.11), along +z in validation/wcl/vwcl.py; sensitivity d0 in {0.3, 1.0} m and an on-line AP with the MU segment starting at c in {0.05, 0.1, 0.2} m
kernel: area-tied K1 (DESIGN.md 5.3), not the letter's Eq. (2); nothing is stated about Eq. (2) until the letter's authors confirm (DESIGN.md 1.6 rule 6, H-3)
